_comment: WATANI GRP Water Tank -- STEEL ACCESSORIES sheet layout spec (version 2).
One sheet per HEIGHT GRADE, mirroring the original YS ACC deck
(Internal_Reinforcement_Assembly, section 4 "Panel Configuration"), where
each height gets its own slide showing two views of the panel next to a part
legend whose contents change with the height. steel_accessories.js renders
this to SVG and binds every position to (a) a PART MASTER DB part number and
(b) a quantity rule.
AUTHORING ORDER is position-first: draw the panel, put a position on it,
choose the part for that position, then define how many of it the tank needs.
A position is fully usable before it is ever bound to a legacy formula row.
IT DOES NOT CHANGE ANY BOM QUANTITY. The BOM still comes from
AccessoriesEngine.reinforcingRowDetail(); this file decides what is drawn,
what part sits at each position, and what each position claims its quantity
is -- which the app shows side by side with the formula so the two can be
reconciled by hand.
COORDINATES are in METRES on the panel elevation, origin = bottom-left. x
runs 0..cols (cols = the reference panel count, NOT the tank width -- these
are standard-arrangement reference sheets). y runs 0..H_O. In members[] any
coordinate may be a number OR a formula string in { H_O, H_C, H_F }; inside
heightSpecs[] they are always literal numbers.
PANEL COURSES: wall panels are 1x1, 1x1.5, 1x2 and 1x0.5 m and each height
is a specific stack of them (panel_rules.js COURSE_TABLE). Steel accessories
are installed AT THE JOINTS between panels, so the renderer draws the real
seams for the grade -- e.g. 3mH is TOP_20(2m) over LOWER(1m), one joint at
y=1 -- and vertical dragging snaps onto those joints.
DIAGRAM FIELDS
views[]        {id,title} the panel faces (Outside/Inside). Orthogonal to
layers[]. Omit for a single unnamed face.
layers[]       {id,title} 보강재(bar) vs 브라켓(bracket) rows.
heights[]      which height grades this diagram defines.
heightSpecs{}  per-height definitions, keyed by height string:
{ mode: "manual", members: [...] }  detached from members[]
Only DETACHED heights appear. A height with no entry is
"auto": baked on the fly from members[] so it keeps tracking
edits to the shared definition. A height detaches on its
first edit; other heights are unaffected.
rowScope[]     rows this drawing is responsible for (reverse audit).
MEMBER (= one POSITION) FIELDS
geom           kind: h {y,x1,x2} | v {x,y1,y2} | rect {x1,x2,y,h,open}
| marker {xs[],yFrom,yStep,yTo}  (a bracket PATTERN:
it stamps one bracket per x per course, so it is not
one element -- see memberInstanceCount())
view / layer   which face and which row of the sheet it belongs to
partNo         the part at this position. ANY catalog part may be chosen
here -- a position is a slot, and a different product can be
substituted in it. Leave null to auto-resolve from the row
(REQUIRED for SA2/SA4 parts so the bolt-spec choice still
decides the suffix).
scale          THE QUANTITY RULE FOR THIS POSITION: how many times ONE
drawn element occurs in the whole tank, as a formula in the
engine scope (W_C W_F L_C L_F H_O H_C H_F N_PA L2_O S_1M,
plus intermediates totLC totLF perim perim3).
Position quantity = scale x (drawn elements).
null means UNKNOWN -- the app reports 미산정 and refuses to
guess a number. 26 of the 64 shipped positions have a scale
that was verified mechanically (it reproduces its row total
across four tank configurations at every height it is drawn
at); the rest are left null on purpose, because their row is
shared by several distinct positions and the split between
them is a domain decision, not something derivable.
rowId          cross-check binding to
AccessoriesRules.reinforcing.<ruleSet>.rows[].id. Optional.
aliasLabel     the label printed on the original sheet where it differs
from the DB part number (e.g. drawing WBR-1610Z is DB
WCP-1610Z). The (INSIDE)/(Outside) markers in these labels
are what seeded the view assignment.
Fine positioning can be adjusted in the app's 도면 편집 mode and re-exported
over this file (JSON 내보내기), so git stays the source of truth.

members.note: 상부 중앙 ㄷ자 보강재. 수식 row45는 S_1M==0(1x1 전용 아님)일 때만 발생 -- 1x1 도면에 없는 것과 일치.
row41은 H_O가 4 / 4.5 / 5 일 때만 발생 -- 원본 도면 범례와 일치.
0.5m(하프) 패널 코스 이음선. 반높이 등급에서 상부 하프 코스 경계.
row38은 H_O>4 에서만 발생. 원본 상단 마스터 범례에는 있으나 높이별 범례에는 누락되어 있어 검증 패널에서 확인 필요.
row47은 H_O==5 에서만 발생.
DB 정식 품번은 WCP-1760SA2/SA4 (내부 타이로드 브라켓 1홀). SA2/SA4는 볼트 사양에 따라 자동 해석.
DB 정식 품번은 WCP-17160SA2/SA4 (내부 타이로드 브라켓 2홀).
도면 표기 WBR-1780Z(Outside) -- PART MASTER DB 정식 품번은 WCP-1780Z. 원본 워크북에 수량식이 없어 row_ext_brk_1780 을 신규 정의(초기값 0)했다. 실제 수량식을 입력해야 BOM에 반영된다.
PART MASTER DB에 없던 품번이라 WBR-1860Z (ANGLE HDG - 180mmX60mmX6mm) 를 신규 등록하고 row_ext_brk_1860 을 신규 정의(초기값 0)했다. 중량/단가와 실제 수량식 입력 필요.
row55은 H_O>3 에서만 발생하는 측판 하부 브라켓.
row43은 S_1M>0(1x1 전용) 항이 있어 1.5mH부터 발생 -- 1x1 도면에 1200Z가 없고 0950Z가 나타나는 것과 일치.
1x1 전용 탱크에는 하프 패널이 없어 row39의 (W_F+totLF) 항은 0이 되고, 격벽 항만 남는다 -- 도면에서도 3.5mH 이상에서만 표기됨.
도면 표기 WBR-1780Z(Outside) -- DB 정식 품번 WCP-1780Z.
row38은 H_O>4 에서만 발생. 원본 2페이지 마스터 범례에 포함됨.
도면 표기 1200SA2/SA4 -- WFB-1205SA2/SA4 가 DB에 없어 신규 등록했다. SA2/SA4 접미사는 볼트 사양에 따라 자동 해석되므로 partNo는 비워 둔다.
row12는 H_O>2.5 조건이나 (H_C+H_F-3) 계수 때문에 실제로는 3.5mH 이상에서만 수량이 발생한다.
row8_T8은 (L2_O>0 && H_O>=3) 조건 -- row8_W8과 동일 부품의 별도 산출 항.
도면 표기 1200SA2/SA4 -- 신규 등록한 WFB-1205SA2/SA4 에 연결.
도면 표기 1200SA2/SA4 -- 신규 등록한 WFB-1205SA2/SA4 에 연결.
row8_T8은 (L2_O>0 && H_O>=3) 조건 -- row8_W8과 동일 부품의 별도 산출 항.
row12는 H_O>2.5 조건이나 (H_C+H_F-3) 계수 때문에 실제로는 3.5mH 이상에서만 수량이 발생한다.
